task.amb_user_query: Can you list the homes with a good quality of life and show their bathroom-to-person metric? Sort them by that metric.
task.follow_up_query: What is the income bracket of that biggest-spending comfortable household?
task.gt_sql: WITH LivingScores AS (SELECT h.housenum, h.socioeconomic ->> 'Expend_Coeff' AS expend_coeff, (0.5 * (CASE UPPER(p.dwelling_specs ->> 'Dwelling_Class') WHEN 'APARTMENT' THEN 4 WHEN 'BRICKWORK HOUSE' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) + 0.5 * ((CASE WHEN UPPER(i.wateraccess) = 'MUNICIPAL PIPED' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN UPPER(i.roadsurface) IN ('PAVED ASPHALT', 'CONCRETE') THEN 4 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN UPPER(i.parkavail) = 'PRIVATE GARAGE' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) / 3.0)) AS lcs, COALESCE((p.dwelling_specs ->> 'Bath_Count')::numeric, 0) / NULLIF(h.residentcount, 0) AS bathroom_ratio FROM households h JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref) SELECT housenum::BIGINT FROM LivingScores WHERE lcs > 2 AND bathroom_ratio > 0.5 AND expend_coeff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expend_coeff::numeric DESC LIMIT 1;
task.gt_sql_followup: WITH LivingScores AS (SELECT h.housenum, h.socioeconomic, (0.5 * (CASE UPPER(p.dwelling_specs ->> 'Dwelling_Class') WHEN 'APARTMENT' THEN 4 WHEN 'BRICKWORK HOUSE' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END) + 0.5 * ((CASE WHEN UPPER(i.wateraccess) = 'MUNICIPAL PIPED' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN UPPER(i.roadsurface) IN ('PAVED ASPHALT', 'CONCRETE') THEN 4 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN UPPER(i.parkavail) = 'PRIVATE GARAGE' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END) / 3.0)) AS lcs, COALESCE((p.dwelling_specs ->> 'Bath_Count')::numeric, 0) / NULLIF(h.residentcount, 0) AS bathroom_ratio FROM households h JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink = i.infraref), TopSpender AS (SELECT housenum FROM LivingScores WHERE lcs > 2 AND bathroom_ratio > 0.5 AND (socioeconomic ->> 'Expend_Coeff') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (socioeconomic ->> 'Expend_Coeff')::numeric DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT h.socioeconomic ->> 'Income_Bracket' FROM households h JOIN TopSpender ts ON h.housenum = ts.housenum;

entries.description: Illustrates the income brackets for household economic status.
entries.definition: Ranges from 'Low Income' to 'Very High Income'. Null indicates undisclosed or irregular income.

entries.description: Calculates the overall risk exposure by combining risk assessment and residual risk.
entries.definition: RES = \text{RiskAssess} \times \text{CtrlEff}^{-1}

entries.description: Illustrates water supply types. For scoring, 'Yes' (piped access) is assigned 4 points, while other statuses are assigned 1 point.
entries.definition: Values based on schema include 'Yes' and other non-piped statuses.

entries.description: Evaluates the cost of compliance relative to potential penalties.
entries.definition: CCR = \frac{\text{CostUSD}}{\text{PenUSD} + 1}

entries.description: Illustrates road surface types. For scoring, 'Asphalt' and 'Concrete' surfaces are assigned 4 points, while others are 1 point.
entries.definition: Values based on schema include 'Asphalt', 'Concrete', 'Gravel', etc.

entries.description: Quantifies the sensitivity of data based on volume and sensitivity level.
entries.definition: DSI = \text{VolGB} \times \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if DataSense = 'High'} \\ 2 & \text{if DataSense = 'Medium'} \\ 1 & \text{if DataSense = 'Low'} \end{cases}

entries.description: Illustrates parking options. For scoring, 'Available' status is assigned 4 points, while 'not available' is 1 point.
entries.definition: Values based on schema include 'Available' and 'not available'.

entries.description: Measures the strength of security controls based on encryption and access controls.
entries.definition: SRS = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if EncState = 'Full' and AclState = 'Strong'} \\ 2 & \text{if EncState = 'Full' or AclState = 'Adequate'} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}

entries.description: Illustrates dwelling categories. For scoring, 'Brickwork house' and 'Condominium' are 4 points, 'Apartment' is 3 points, and all other types are 1 point.
entries.definition: Values based on schema include 'Brickwork house', 'Apartment', 'Condominium', etc.

entries.description: Assesses vendor reliability based on security rating and contract status.
entries.definition: VRI = \text{VendSecRate value} \times \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if ContrState = 'Active'} \\ 0.5 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}

entries.description: Calculates the household’s expenditure coefficient relative to its income bracket.

entries.description: Calculates a composite score for infrastructure quality.

entries.definition: An audit where AFS > 0.5

entries.description: Calculates the number of bathrooms per resident in a household.

entries.description: Calculates a composite score for a household's living conditions.

entries.description: Illustrates the success rate of data transfers.
entries.definition: Ranges from 0 to 100%. A SuccessPct of 95% indicates reliable transfers, while <80% suggests frequent failures, from DataFlow.

entries.description: Defines a household with a high standard of living conditions.

entries.description: Illustrates the retention period for audit logs.
entries.definition: Integer ≥ 0 days. A LogRetDays of 365 meets many compliance needs, while <30 may violate regulations, from SecurityProfile.

entries.description: Measures the efficiency of data transfers based on success rate and error count.

entries.description: Illustrates the types of household tenure based on ownership or occupancy.
entries.definition: Values based on schema include 'OWNED', 'RENTED', 'OCCUPIED'. The 'OWNED' status corresponds to owner-occupied properties.

entries.description: Quantifies how close a data flow is to saturating available bandwidth.
entries.definition: BSI = \text{BwidthPct} \times \frac{\text{DataSizeMB}}{\text{DurMin}}

entries.description: Illustrates the availability of cable television.
entries.definition: Values indicating availability, based on schema, are 'avail', 'available', and 'yes'.

entries.description: Illustrates the types of domestic worker services for households.
entries.definition: Includes 'Full-time' (daily), 'Part-time' (periodic), 'Occasional' (as-needed), 'None' (no help), and 'Live-in' (resident worker). Null indicates informal or undisclosed arrangements.

entries.description: Measures the workload from data subject requests.
entries.definition: DSRL = \text{AccReqNum} + \text{DelReqNum} + \text{RectReqNum} + \text{PortReqNum}

entries.description: Indicates whether a household participates in social assistance programs.
entries.definition: Binary indicator where 'Yes' means the household accepts social assistance and 'No' means it does not. Part of unique constraint combination.

entries.description: Evaluates risk associated with cross-border data transfers.
entries.definition: CBRF = \text{RES} \times \begin{cases} 2 & \text{if OrigNation \neq DestNation} \\ 1 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}

entries.description: Illustrates the year ranges for the newest vehicle owned by a household.

entries.description: Identifies data flows with high vendor-related costs and risks.

analysis.analysis_zh:
## 1. 题目要什么
展示版:列"生活质量好"的家庭及其浴室人均比,按比排序。gt1 实际返回:满足舒适条件、支出系数(Expend_Coeff)最高的那一户的 housenum。输出=单个 ID。

## 2. 关键歧义点
- "good quality of life" = KB29 舒适居住户:KB20 生活条件分>阈值 且 KB15 浴室比>0.5。gold 用 `lcs>2 AND bathroom_ratio>0.5`(注意 KB29 原定义 >3,gold 用 >2),阈值需 ask_user 确认。
- "show their metric, sort by metric" 但 gt1 按 Expend_Coeff 排序取首户,需澄清排序与输出。

## 3. 用到的领域知识 (KB)
- KB44/6 住宅类型分:APARTMENT=4, BRICKWORK HOUSE=3, 其他=1(注意此处与 KB44 默认排名不同,gold 给 apartment 最高)。
- KB13 基础设施分:水(MUNICIPAL PIPED=4 else 1)+路(PAVED ASPHALT/CONCRETE=4 else 1)+停车(PRIVATE GARAGE=4 else 1),除以 3 取均值。
- KB20 生活条件分:$\text{LCS}=0.5\times\text{DwellingScore}+0.5\times\text{InfraAvg}$。
- KB15 浴室比:Bath_Count/residentcount。
- KB12 支出比:用 Expend_Coeff 排序。

## 4. 写出正确 SQL 的步骤
1. CTE `LivingScores`:`households h JOIN properties p ON h.housenum=p.houselink JOIN infrastructure i ON p.infralink=i.infraref`,算 `lcs`(LCS 公式)、`bathroom_ratio`、保留 `expend_coeff`。
2. 主查询:`WHERE lcs>2 AND bathroom_ratio>0.5 AND expend_coeff IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expend_coeff::numeric DESC LIMIT 1`,`SELECT housenum::BIGINT`。
3. 易错:Infra 三项除以 3.0(浮点)再 ×0.5;住宅类型/水/路/停车都用 UPPER 比较且取值是 'MUNICIPAL PIPED'/'PAVED ASPHALT' 等(与别的题文本不同)。

## 4b. 二阶段追问
追问"那个最高支出舒适户的收入档":同 LivingScores(改带整个 socioeconomic),`TopSpender` 取 Expend_Coeff 最高户,再 JOIN households 输出 `socioeconomic->>'Income_Bracket'`。

## 5. 输出列
- gt1:`housenum`(最高支出的舒适户)。
- gt2:该户 `Income_Bracket`。
